supports: IOs powered by VDD3P3_RTC can wake the chip from Deep-sleep (esp_deep_sleep_enable_gpio_wakeup)

title: ESP32-C3 Series SoC Errata (latest), [ADC-183] The Digital Controller (DMA) of SAR ADC2 Cannot Work
supports: affected revisions v0.0-v1.1; the DIG ADC2 controller may receive a false sampling enable signal and enter an inoperative state
workaround: use SAR ADC1; no fix scheduled
says nothing about ADC2 oneshot reads
